purpose: Classify whether a local agent may be trusted for a repository without conflating remote integration, checkout freshness, agent projection parity, live host runtime proof, remote-write reachability, or actual push proof.

runtime_boundary.optional_remote_refresh: git fetch only; no working-tree mutation
runtime_boundary.optional_remote_write_probe: git push --dry-run only; no ref mutation

non_goals: promote CI proof to workstation proof
proof_ceiling: Synthetic isolated-consumer tests prove classifier semantics. Workstation readiness requires consumer-provided live-host and Git/provider evidence.
